The '''GT-23 Plasma Assault Cannon''' was a model of portable [[Blaster cannon/Legends|blaster cannon]] available during the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]].

==Behind the scenes==
The GT-23 Plasma Assault Cannon was first added to the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' as part of the Core Worlds and Deep Core Explorer Packs, which were released together on [[May 4]], [[2015]].
